label: Persist to majority
type: the durability level requiring the mutation to be persisted to disk on a majority of nodes before acknowledgement - the strongest level, and unavailable to ephemeral buckets, which persist nothing.
note: See durability:level-majority for the incompleteness caveat. Its exclusion from ephemeral buckets is the sharpest interaction this batch found between two of its own families: a bucket type constrains which durability levels exist for it, which is a real product constraint and the kind of cross-family fact the whole exercise is meant to make queryable.
